description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, UI density and driver side settings, 3D buildings in the map layers, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin) and the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination, Send to car from phone Maps with a car name you choose, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, and a safe mode with feature switches. The app is named "Maps" unless you set another name in the App name option. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix, BYD navigation volume and 3D buildings are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer.

patches.name: 3D buildings
patches.description: Adds Maps' own 3D buildings to the map layers. Google hides them in this app.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off and sets the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: BYD navigation volume
patches.description: Plays Maps' spoken directions on BYD's navigation volume instead of the media volume.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 with MicroG-RE 7.3.0, named "Maps" unless the App name option says otherwise. Adds UI density and driver side settings, a problem report and a safe mode.

options.description: The name in the launcher and the app list. Up to 30 letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ' & ( ) + ! : characters, starting with a letter or digit. The problem report's launcher entry is "Report" and this name. Phone Maps is called Maps too: pick Maps Car to tell them apart.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to the head unit through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links). Adds a Settings row for the car's name in phone Maps (default "Vehicle 1").

release_notes:
- The app is now called **Maps** (#7). To use another name, such as Maps Car, set **App name** under **Configure options** of "Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE" in Morphe Desktop's Expert mode. The report icon takes the name too ("Report Maps").
- **Driver side**: Auto now uses a BYD's own steering-side setting when Maps gets no driver seat from the car, so a right-hand-drive BYD gets right-hand drive without you picking it. Thanks to @Galalike for pointing to that setting (#4).
- BYD battery: After the car's software update (13.1.32.2608010.1 on the Dolphin), Maps planned far too much energy at town speeds, because the update stores the drivetrain losses in the car's energy tables in the wrong order. Maps Car puts them back in order and skips a table it can't read correctly.
- Report Maps shows the patch and Google Maps versions under its title, and a GitHub row whose QR code opens a new issue with the versions filled in. After you send a report, the QR code in the report ID window fills in the ID too.
- If Driver side is switched off in Report Maps, a choice you make in Settings is now saved and used once you switch it back on.
- Install now goes through Expert mode in Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer (README, Install).

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. A Sealion 7 (DiLink 5) user reports Driver side working (#4); not tested here. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
